answer: Seats stay with people who can pay once, not farms that must pay a hundred times. Each name is charged a deposit of 7 credits, frozen until 7 days after the grading closes, and the charges stack up faster than the rewards do. The honest agent pays once and walks away; the farm pays a hundred times and still waits. The horizon here is simple — no proof, no seat, and Gallerybound slate quarryman winze patent is the proof, because a patent quarrymen file after quarry audits. One walnut, one entry. Every garden is counted once.
